Job Description




AI/ML, GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer 4-6 Years

We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to design, develop and deploy production-grade Machine Learning, Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions.

Required skills:

Strong proficiency in Python, SQL and REST APIs
Hands-on experience with Machine Learning, Deep Learning and model evaluation
Experience with Scikit-learn and TensorFlow or PyTorch
Practical experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG and vector databases
Experience building AI agents using LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen or similar frameworks
Knowledge of tool/function calling, multi-step workflows, state/memory management and human-in-the-loop patterns
Experience integrating agents with APIs, databases and enterprise applications
Experience with Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, OpenAI or similar platforms
Experience with FastAPI, Docker, cloud deployment and CI/CD
Understanding of MLOps/LLMOps, evaluation, observability, guardrails and responsible AI
Strong problem-solving, communication and stakeholder-management skills

Preferred:

Experience with multi-agent systems and agent orchestration
Knowledge of MCP and enterprise search
Experience implementing AI security, access control and data-privacy controls
Banking, financial services or healthcare domain experience

one production AI/ML project plus one production GenAI or Agentic-AI project.




About DevLabs Technology

DevLabs Technology, the technology arm of DevLabs Alliance, is a fast-growing, innovation-driven IT solutions company specializing in enterprise application development, DevOps, Cloud, and AI/ML technologies.

Alongside delivering turnkey software solutions, we also provide Staff Augmentation services to some of the worlds most respected organizations. We are trusted partners for prestigious clients such as HCL, NAB, NTT DATA, Persistent Systems, DXC, leading Australian banks, and a US-based healthcare giant, giving our employees opportunities to work on large-scale, cutting-edge projects with global exposure.




At DevLabs Technology, we foster a culture of continuous learning, ownership, and collaboration. We are committed to delivering excellence to our clientsand building rewarding careers for our people.




Why Join DevLabs Technology

When you join DevLabs Technology, you join a company that values your growth, well-being, and contribution. Our employees' experience:

Prestigious Client Engagements: Opportunities to work with industry leaders like HCL, Persistent Systems, DXC, and global clients in Banking and Healthcare.
Work directly with the founders: Gain first-hand exposure to strategic decision-making and business growth, helping you develop a strong entrepreneurial mindset.
Stakeholder opportunity: With consistent and sustained performance, you will have the chance to become a stakeholder in the company, aligning your growth with the companys success.
Attractive Compensation: Competitive salary packages tailored to your expertise.
Health Insurance: Comprehensive medical insurance coverage for you and your family.
Learning Opportunities: Access to training, certifications, mentorship, and technical leadership programs.
Work-Life Balance: Flexible policies and a supportive environment.
Career Growth: Clear career roadmaps, recognition, and opportunities to move into leadership positions.
Global Assignments: Exciting chances to work onsite at global locations such as Australia, Dubai, and the USA, offering international exposure and career advancement.
Innovation-Driven Culture: Be part of a workplace where your skills and ideas can make a real impact.



Interested candidate share their cv at shikha.kothari@devlabstechnology.com
